responses: Hello! Welcome to McDonald's. Would you like to place an order today?
Awesome! What main item can I get you today? We have the Big Mac, Quarter Pounder, McCrispy, and McNuggets.
Excellent choice! I've added the {item} to your ticket. Would you like to make that item a value meal combo, or just keep it standalone?
Sure thing! Which size combo would you prefer for your {item}? Small, medium, or large?
Got it, a {size} combo! What side would you like with that? You can choose World Famous Fries, Apple Slices, or a Side Salad.
Perfect, {size} {side} it is! Now let's pick a drink. We have fountain sodas (Coke, Sprite, Fanta) or premium choices like an Iced Coffee or Milkshake.
Added to your order! So far I have a quantity of {quantity} {size} {item} meal with {side}. Would you like to add another item, or is that everything for today?
Excellent, {name}. Will you be paying via cash at the pickup window, or using a mobile card payment right now?
Perfect, your transaction is processed. Your order is now complete. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Awesome. Enjoy your meal, {name}, and have a great day! Remember to type 'exit' or 'quit' to close your drive-thru receipt.
